hash_algorithm: SHA-256; canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no nonfinite numbers
forcing_selection: accepted-handoff-only; no download, fallback or online rebase
naive_time_policy: preserve accepted dataset clock; timezone=auto is not UTC authority
aware_time_policy: preserve source explicit offset and exact handoff epoch; no implicit UTC normalization
plant_anchor_role: declared before execution; runtime attachment cannot rebase it
runtime_clock_scope: observed FCU source-to-dataset projection and host-boot-identified monotonic receipt
clock_rates: measure diagnostic deltas; never assume plant time equals host elapsed time
absolute_clock_synchronization: not asserted; no host UTC to dataset mapping for unspecified timestamps
forcing_application_scope: R4.03 horizontal wind parameter readback; unsupported fields explicitly unavailable
published_binding_identity: one TDOC publication; no replacement at FCU connection
